name: Khalid Abdallah
bio: Mr. Khalid Abdallah brings over 30 years of distinguished technology leadership to his role as Chairman, currently serving as Chief Technology Officer for the Information Systems and Infrastructure Group at the National Bank of Egypt (NBE), where he has orchestrated transformational digital infrastructure initiatives across three data centers, card management solutions, networking architecture, cybersecurity operations (SOC), and comprehensive monitoring systems.

name: Mohamed El Attar
bio: Mr. El Attar is leading Egypt’s digital transformation as the Vice Minister for Digital Transformation, Automation and Administrative Development at the Ministry of Communications and Information Technology (MCIT) since June 2018. He is also holding the position of the Head of IT Infrastructure Sector at MCIT since 2015. Mr. El Attar has more than 35 years of experience in the field of informatics, supervising more than 150 projects in this field in Egypt, Saudi Arabia, UAE, Bahrain, Germany and USA. He has held multiple managerial positions at IBM for 28 years, as well as Raya, and worked as a lecturer at Cairo University. Mr. El Attar has a Bachelor’s degree in engineering with honors, and a Master’s degree in business administration from the Arab Academy for Science, Technology and Maritime Transport (AASTMT), in addition to a Master’s degree in research at the University of Liverpool.

name: Serry
bio: Mr. Serry brings on board over 40 years of experience in the IT industry & human capital development. Mr. Serry has been a Board Member since 2017. He has also held several Board Member positions in some giant organizations in Egypt like Egypt Post, and TE Data, to name a few.

name: Hassan Helmy
bio: Mr. Hassan Helmy brings over 35 years of distinguished experience in finance, audit, and corporate governance, currently serving as Board Member and Audit Committee Chairman for several leading Egyptian corporations. His exceptional career includes serving as Senior Partner at a major Big Four firm where he led Egypt’s largest audit practice.

name: Ahmed Ibrahim
bio: Mr. Ibrahim has been appointed as a Board Member in 2020. He brings on board a wealth of over 37 years of experience in the financial industry. He is currently the Head of Financial Affairs at the National Postal Authority (Egypt Post). During his tenure with Egypt Post, he assumed several leading roles within the financial sector of the organization. Mr. Ibrahim graduated from the Faculty of Commerce and Business Administration, Helwan University in 1987.

name: Mahfouz
bio: Mr. Mahfouz is the CEO of El-Delta Electronic Systems and worked as a Senior Advisor for the Economic Governance Activity project with the USAID where he is helping them to address the digital transformation project of the Egyptian Government. In July 2020, Mr. Mahfouz was named the CEO of Egypt’s Information Technology Industry Development Agency (ITIDA). Mr. Mahfouz has led a number of strategic projects and key presidential initiatives nationwide that strongly cemented Egypt’s position on the global ICT map and contributed to promoting Egypt’s IT sector in key markets. Mr. Mahfouz holds a B.Sc. in Engineering from Cairo University and a Master of Business Administration (MBA) from Maastricht School of Management in the Netherlands.

name: Omar Khattab
bio: In addition to the above, Mr. Khattab is also a Board Member at the Egyptian Ferro Alloys Company, The Chemical Industries Holding Company, as well as being a Board Member of Egypt post, and the Head of the Investment Committee. Mr. Khattab is also the President of the Egyptian Financial Markets Association (ACI-Egypt), which is a non-profit organization for the dealers and treasurers at the financial sector. Mr. Khattab holds a bachelor’s degree from the Faculty of Commerce, Cairo University, and an MBA in Banking and Finance from the Arab Academy for Science & Maritime Transportation.

name: Noha Adly
bio: Dr. Adly is the Advisor to the Minister of Communication & Information Technology for R&D and the R&D director of the Applied Innovation Center. She has served in several positions since 1988 locally and abroad. Dr. Adly served as Head of ICT sector at Bibliotheca Alexandrina for more than 20 years, where she was responsible for the BA’s overall ICT strategy & the design and implementation of its digital initiatives.
